column20: MODEL11: Working Capital uses segment cash-conversion DSOs blended by FY2025 10-K revenue mix (SaaS, on-prem software, B2C myFICO, B2B Scores, Professional services). NWC = AR + Inventory − AP − Deferred Revenue (output); ΔNWC = NWCt − NWCt−1. Mix percentages offset within Total Revenue — they do not add a second revenue stack. FY2025 10-K disaggregation ($000s): B2B Scores 948,595; B2C myFICO 219,980; SaaS software 419,720; on-premises software 320,425; Professional services 82,149 (sum = Total revenues 1,990,869). FICO Platform ARR was $263.6M (35% of software ARR) at 9/30/2025 — ARR is a KPI, not an incremental IS line. SaaS/on-prem billings create Deferred Revenue (contract liability); B2C is near-zero DSO (card-settled); B2B Scores use ~30-day trade terms; Professional services convert cash quickly but at much lower gross margin (~28% vs software/scores). AR is organic from blended collections days — no top-down NWC% AR plug. Deferred Revenue is an explicit Balance Sheet liability included in Total Liabilities and in NWC (= AR+Inv−AP−Deferred). Forecast Deferred = Total Rev × (SaaS% + OnPrem%) × (FY25 Deferred ÷ FY25 software revenue). Only software subscription / maintenance billings drive the liability — Scores and myFICO are not double-counted into Deferred.
